name: Frog by Adam Handling
address: 34-35 Southampton Street, Covent Garden, London, WC2E 7HG

menus.name: Tasting menu
menus.note: Two optional supplements. Pairings: matching wine £155, premium £255, Cali & Burgundy £555, alcohol-free £85.

menus.name: Plant-based tasting menu
menus.note: Plant-based version of the tasting menu.

menus.name: Four-course lunch menu
menus.note: Tuesday to Saturday, 12pm to 1pm; a choice of three dishes per course. Matching wine £60, premium £120; optional supplements (£40 lobster wagyu, £15 cheese course).

bookingOpens: Online through OpenTable, or by phone or email (info@frogbyadamhandling.com). Lunch is Tuesday to Saturday, 12pm to 1pm; dinner Monday to Wednesday 5pm to 9:30pm and Thursday to Saturday 5pm to 10pm; closed Sunday.
groups: The Library private dining room seats up to 12, with the tasting menu or a menu built around the group's chosen ingredients; larger groups by arrangement through info@frogbyadamhandling.com.
